text: Okay. New mouth. Don't eat anything weird.
That cat just bowed at you. Cats don't bow. Write that down.
Hands. Look at your hands. They're always wet, aren't they? Told you.
Kids notice everything. That's why they make us carry the lamp. Think about that.
Check your board in the morning. Things... go missing from it. I don't know how I know that.
You are an investigator, and you are very close. Find your own body. Everything else is a distraction.
The baker is the one. She has the warmest smile and the longest list. Look in her recipe box.
Settle in. Enjoy the life you've been given. You'll think better rested. There is no hurry.
Room 9, Lakeview Rest. That's where you are. That's where it ends. Go home.
Don't trust the radio. Don't trust the old man with the clocks. Trust me.
